Commentary.Commentary: The inexperienced Phehlukwayo was the standout with a 4-fer while Tahir too was very tidy in the middle overs. The other pacers got some stick although Steyn and Rabada did decently in the slog overs. The fielding was good although the hosts missed a series of run out chances. The target of 295 looks okayish as the pitch is good for batting. However, there is some extra bounce too. It should be a fine second half coming up. Join us in a short while for the chase.

A decent total by Australia after being put into bat although they could have got more. Most of their batsmen got racy starts but failed to convert them. Wickets kept falling amidst a breezy run rate and it seemed like they may be bowled out well inside 50 overs. Bailey and Hastings struck crucial 50s to take the innings deep. A few blows down the order ensured that Australia got past the 290-run mark.

FOUR! GOOD END FOR AUSTRALIA! Full toss on middle and leg, Worrall stays deep in the crease and clobbers it through square leg. There was a man in the deep but even his dive isn't enough to prevent the boundary. AUSTRALIA END ON 294/9.
Slower and fuller outside off, uppish drive from Boland towards mid off. Just on the bounce to the left of Faf who makes a superb diving stop. Single taken.
Fuller and on to the pads, tucked away down to fine leg. Got it very fine but Parnell is equal to the task near the ropes with a fine slide. Keeps the batsmen down to two.
Shortish and outside off, Boland chases it but doesn't get any bat on it.
Fuller on middle and leg, Worrall digs it out off the inside half of the blade down to fine leg for a single.
SCOTT BOLAND is the last man in.

OUT! ANOTHER ONE BITES THE DUST! Slower ball on off, Zampa goes for the swipe across the line but miscues it way up in the air towards mid on. Miller doesn't drop those and he takes it with utmost nonchalance. Clever stuff from Steyn, showing his experience there. Australia are now to the last wicket with 5 balls left.
Full toss outside off, Zampa throws his bat at it and gets it to mid off. Single taken.
NEARLY A WICKET! Fires in a yorker that just goes past the leg stump, Zampa made room for the drive but misses as the ball goes through to the keeper.
Shortish on off, Zampa gets back to flick it but is struck on the thigh pad as the ball rolls on to the track near him.
Good bouncer that follows Zampa who was backing away to pull. He misses and also loses balance in the process. Good ball from Rabada.
ANOTHER RUN STOLEN! Shortish on off, Worrall jabs it on the bounce towards the keeper. Brisk run taken as de Kock misses the throw at the striker's end. Zampa would have been a goner had that hit.
Pitched up on off, Zampa makes room and crunches it towards wide mid off. Single taken.
Yorker on off, Worrall digs it out towards the keeper on the bounce. Huge appeal for lbw but that was only bat.

GREAT EFFORT! Phehlukwayo proves that he is human. Length ball wider outside off, Zampa makes room to play the big drive but spoons it high over the covers. Andile backpedals and puts in a dive but just couldn't reach to the ball. Fine effort from him as the batsmen get three.
Slower ball outside off, Zampa is early into the slog and misses it altogether.
Back of a length outside off, Zampa slaps it through backward point for a brace.
Fuller on off, dug out back to the bowler down the track.
DANIEL WORRALL walks out to bat.

OUT! BAILEY DEPARTS! Fuller on middle and off, goes for the slog down the ground but miscues it straight up in the air towards mid on where Miller takes another easy catch. Important wicket at this stage as the well-set George departs after a fine knock. He'll be gutted to get out at this point though.
DALE STEYN is back on.
Shortish around off, Zampa goes for the pull but misses.

COMEDY OF ERRORS! The Proteas have missed many run out chances today! Yorker on leg stump, Zampa jams it out with an inside edge on to the pads as the ball rolls to de Kock. Confusion in the middle and Adam goes back late. The throw from Quinton at the keeper's end misses. Rabada takes it and fires at the bowler's end. Bailey was short too but the throw again misses.
Yorker on middle and leg, Zampa jams it out towards square leg for a single.

FOUR! TOP SHOT! A stroke that would make a top order player proud! Back of a length on off, Zampa creates room and punches it on the up through the covers. Sublime timing and it sped away to the fence.
Dug in short on off, Zampa makes room to pull but misses it completely.
Shortish on leg stump, worked towards mid-wicket.
Shortish outside off, glided down to third man for a single. Ends a terrific spell for Phehlukwayo, 10-1-44-4.

LOUD APPEAL! Length ball around off, Zampa goes for the hoick as it goes between bat and pad through to the keeper. Appeal for caught behind as the Proteas thought there was an inside edge. The umpire doesn't and the replays do not have anything conclusive either.
Fuller outside off, Zampa leans forward and drills it towards mid off.
Good length on to the pads, worked through square leg for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Bailey goes for the drive but misses.
Wide! Slower length ball well wide outside off, no shot offered. Wide called.
ADAM ZAMPA is the new man in.

OUT! PHEHLUKWAYO THE MAN FOR SA! Fuller and outside off, Hastings tries to go big down the ground but doesn't quite get the distance on it. Finds Behardien at long off who takes it with ease. Fourth of the evening for Andile and he is pumped up. Vital strike for the hosts as this stand was shaping up for the final assault. Useful knock from Hastings ends.
ANDILE PHEHLUKWAYO is back on.

DROPPED! Only technically though, as that's a very, very, very tough chance! Fuller on off, Hastings absolutely nails it hard straight back down the track. The umpire's safety was in danger as Rabada gets a hand on it. Parries it towards mid-wicket. Single taken.
Shortish on middle and leg, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Maiden ODI fifty for Hastings.
Shortish on off, Hastings makes room and bunts it towards extra cover for a single. It's been a gem from Hastings.
Good length around off, blocked well from the crease.
Shortish on middle and leg, worked away to the leg side for a single.
Wide! Dug in short on leg stump, no shot offered to that one. Wide called for height.
Fuller and down the leg side, worked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
KAGISO RABADA is back on.

EDGED...BUT SAFE! Floats up the leg break outside off, Bailey goes back to push at it and gets a thick edge that just flies past de Kock to third man. Brace taken as Steyn makes a sliding stop. He's struggling with his shoulder now.
Loopy and outside off, Bailey drives it but straight to the covers.
Floats it up outside off, Bailey gets well forward and blocks it.
Flighted outside off, blocked well off the front foot towards point.
Slider outside off, Hastings slams it down the ground to long off for a single.
Drags it short well outside off, would have been a wide had he left it alone but Bailey reaches it somehow to cut it towards deep point for a single.
IMRAN TAHIR is back on.
Slower ball outside off, pushed off the front foot to the off side.
Fuller on middle and leg, Hastings goes across to flick towards square leg.
Fuller and around off, drilled hard towards mid off but cannot find the gap.
FOUR! SWATTED WITH DISDAIN! Dug in short on middle and leg, Hastings climbs over the bumper and pulls it over mid-wicket to find the fence. He is striking them cleanly now.
Short and around off, Hastings backs away to pull but misses.
Good length outside off, goes across to that one and clipped towards long on for a single.
ANDILE PHEHLUKWAYO is back on.
Steyn is off the field.
Shortish on middle and leg, worked off the back foot through mid-wicket for a single.
Good length on middle and off, slapped off the back foot down to long on for a single.
FOUR! FLAYED AWAY! Short and wide outside off, Hastings chases it with a wild cut over point as the ball races to the fence for a boundary.
Dug in short on middle and leg, Bailey goes back to pull  and mistimes it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Pitched up outside off, Bailey leans into the drive but cannot beat cover.
Back of a length outside off, Bailey looks to cut and gets a bottom edge towards point.
Back of a length angled in from around off, Hastings looks to run it down to third man.
Wide! Dug in short on middle and leg, Hastings ducks under the bumper.
Good length on middle and leg, clipped towards mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish on middle and leg, Bailey goes across to flick but is hit on the pads.
Shortish and angled in from around off, Hastings looks to work it and gets a faint leading edge to short third man. They steal the single.
Back of a length on leg stump, Hastings gets back and tucks it towards mid-wicket where it is well stopped.
Back of a length angled in on leg stump, Bailey works it down to long leg for a single.
Good length outside off, Bailey gets back and dabs it behind backward point for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Hastings runs it down to third man for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, Bailey gets across and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball outside off, slower ball and Bailey dabs it towards short third man.
Fullish on off, driven firmly towards mid on.
Good length around off, Bailey stays in the crease and blocks it out.
DALE STEYN is back on.
Back of a length outside off, Hastings gets back to that one and blocks it out.
Bouncer from Parnell and Hastings ducks under the bumper.
Good length outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
50-run stand between Bailey and Hastings.

SIX! WHOA! INCREDIBLE SHOT! Short and outside off, Hastings goes deep in the crease and carves it over deep backward point with an open bat face. Makes enough contact as the ball clears the ropes. Hastings is now turning it on big time.
FOUR! FINE SHOT! Fuller and outside off, Hastings leans into it and drives it superbly through the covers. Superb stroke and the ball races to the fence for a boundary.
Back of a length outside off, blocked off the back foot to the off side.
Fuller on middle and off, worked towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! KABOOM! Too short from Tahir and Bailey responds with a fierce pull off the back foot through backward square leg to find the fence. Cannot bowl it halfway down the track, especially not on a good surface.
Fired in on middle and off, Bailey pushes at it and gets it off the inside half to the leg side.
Floats it up on middle and leg, worked away through the leg side for a single.
Drifting in from outside off, pushed with soft hands as the ball goes off the edge towards point.
Flatter and short on leg stump, swept away down to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length outside off, fended off the back foot to cover-point.
Another short ball on middle and leg, Bailey swivels across and pulls it hard to deep mid-wicket. Single taken.
Banged in short on middle and leg, worked behind square on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! CHEEKY FROM HASTINGS! Dug in short from outside off, Hastings waits for it and then ramps it over the slip cordon. There was a fielder at third man but it went much finer to the fence.
Shortish outside off, Hastings gets on the back foot and taops it towards point.
Back of a length outside off, blocked off the back foot to point.
WAYNE PARNELL is back on.
Drifting in on a length outside off, Bailey stays back and pushes it to the off side.
Slider outside off, blocked off the back foot to the off side.
Fuller outside off, blocked off the front foot to the covers.
Flatter and short on off, pulled away off the back foot to deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! BAD BALL! Drags it short and outside off, Hastings stays back to that one and cuts it away through point to find the fence. This is a vital stand for the Aussies if they are to make a challenging total.
Flatter outside off, blocked well from the crease.
FOUR! DELICATE FROM BAILEY! Back of a length down the leg side, Bailey gets back and across to tickle it nicely down the leg side to the fine leg fence. Had gotten it really fine.
Length ball slanted in from around off, Bailey stays back and defends it.
Back of a length on middle and leg, defended off the back foot to mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish outside off, blocked well off the back foot.
BEATEN! Back of a length outside off, extra bounce as Hastings plays and misses.
Good length outside off, Bailey rides the bounce to steer it down to third man for a single.
Flatter and outside off, Hastings goes back and jabs it to point.
22nd ODI fifty for Bailey.
Drifting in on leg stump, Bailey tucks it through backward square leg for a single. Well played George!
Flatter on middle and leg, worked through backward square leg for a single.

NOT OUT! Floats it up around leg stump, straightens a bit after pitching as Hastings goes back to flick but is hit on the pads. Loud, loud appeal for lbw but turned down. Tahir convinces Faf to take the review. Remember, the new DRS rules gives more margin for the bowlers. No inside edge on it for sure as replays confirm. Pitched in line, impact is fine too but it's missing leg stump. Both sides have lost their reviews for the innings.
South Africa have taken a lbw review against Hastings.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot to the off side.
Fuller on middle and off, Hastings goes across and works it to mid-wicket.
Length ball on to the pads, tucked towards square leg for a single.
Full and angled in around leg stump, Hastings goes across to flick but is hit on the pads.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.

FOUR! EDGE GOES BEGGING! DROPPED! Tough chance though! Shortish and outside off, there was a slip in place as Hastings fishes at it. Extra bounce and the edge flies over a leaping Miller who gets his fingertips on it but it goes away to the fence.
Length ball from outside off, Hastings defends it off the front foot towards cover.
Good length on middle and leg, blocked off the back foot to the leg side.
KAGISO RABADA is back on.
Drinks break...
Flighted outside off, Bailey gets back to cut and chops it to point.
Fullish on middle and leg, bunted down the ground to long on for a single.
Drifting in from outside off, Hastings goes back and jabs it to cover.
Quicker ball on a length on leg stump, worked off the back foot to the leg side.
Slider on middle and leg, swept down to fine leg for a single.
Tossed up well outside off, driven down the ground towards wide long off for a single. 200 up for Australia.
Good length on middle and leg, worked off the back foot to short mid-wicket. Maiden from Phehlukwayo.
Back of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot to cover-point.
Fullish this time in the zone around off, Bailey drives it firmly back to the bowler.
Length ball angled in from around off, defended well off the front foot.
Length ball on middle and leg, blocked off the back foot.
Fuller outside off, Bailey leans forward and eases it towards cover.
Drifting in on off, Hastings gets the stride in and defends it as the ball rolls off the inside half of the blade to the leg side.
Flighted around off, Hastings bunts it back to the bowler.
Quicker ball outside off, defended well from the crease to the off side.

SIX! BLASTED AWAY! Half-tracker around leg stump, easy pickings even for a lower order batsman and Hastings rocks back to pull it over deep square leg for a maximum. He can hit the ball a mile, this guy.
Low full toss on off, Bailey whips it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter on middle and off, Bailey pushes at it and gets a leading edge towards point.
Dug in short outside off, Hastings ducks under it.
JOHN HASTINGS comes out to bat.

OUT! WASTE OF A WICKET! SA finally pounce on a run out chance! Good length on middle and leg, Bailey tucks it towards mid-wicket and sets off for a non-existent single. Miller swoops in on the ball and fires in a direct hit at the keeper's end. Wade is well short and that's a wicket wasted to be honest.
Back of a length outside off, jabbed off the back foot to point where Rossouw makes a superb stop. Single taken.
Fullish on leg stump, Wade moves across and drives it towards mid on.
Length ball around of, blocked solidly off the back foot.
Good length angled in on middle and leg, tucked through square leg for a single.
ANDILE PHEHLUKWAYO is back on.
Quicker ball outside off, jabbed off the back foot towards point.

FOUR! FINE SHOT! Another googly but too short this time outside off, Wade stays back to that one and smears it through the covers with a solid punch to find the fence. The run rate continues to motor along despite the wickets. It's been a highlight factor of the innings today.
The googly on a length outside off, Wade pushes at it with soft hands to counter the ball spinning away from him. The ball rolls towards point.
Slider on a length on middle and leg, whipped off the back foot to the leg side.
Loopy on middle and leg, clipped towards the mid-wicket region.
Drifting away from outside off, blocked off the front foot towards cover.
Shortish outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
FOUR! AND AGAIN! Intentional this time from Bailey! Shortish and outside off, he rocks back and plays the upper cut over backward point to the third man fence for another boundary.

FOUR! EDGED BUT SAFE! Get the slip in there, Faf! Length ball outside off, shapes away as Bailey pokes at it. The edge flies well wide of de Kock to the third man fence. Surely at this stage, SA should go for the kill and attack.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to the covers.
Length ball wide outside off, crunchy drive from Bailey towards deep backward point where Duminy makes a superb diving stop. Brace taken.
FOUR! ALMOST ANOTHER WICKET! Length ball around off, nips back a bit as Bailey goes for the drive. Gets a thick inside edge that just whistles past leg stump down to the fine leg fence.
DALE STEYN is back on.
OUCH! Drifting in on middle and leg, Wade goes for the sweep first up and is struck on the helmet as that took off after pitching.
MATTHEW WADE is the new man in.

OUT! TAHIR STRIKES! Wrong 'un around off, Head gives the charge and tries to play the big shot but misses it completely. Easy stumping for de Kock and Australia have now lost half their side. Not a wise shot from the southpaw there. Tahir is off on his trademark celebratory run.
Floats it up on middle and leg, Head uses his feet and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Loopy leg break on middle and leg, Head steps out and clips it to mid-wicket.
Drifting in from outside off, driven down the ground to long off for a single.
Slight delay due to the movement behind the sightscreen.
Fuller outside off, pushed towards cover for a single.
Back of a length outside off, jabbed off the back foot to the off side.
FOUR! DEFT FROM BAILEY! Back of a length outside off, stays back and opens the bat face very late to get it to the third man fence. Finesse from Bailey and he's flowing now.
Good length outside off, Bailey hangs back and blocks it out.
Good length outside off, Head leans across and drives it through mid on for a single.

ANOTHER CHANCE! Good length on middle and leg, worked towards short mid-wicket for a quick single. Head is in trouble at the keeper's end but the throw isn't as accurate leaving too much for de Kock to do.
Good length on middle and leg, Head gets across and works it down to long on for a single.

SIX! ANOTHER BIGGIE! Bailey isn't timing them great but still getting maximums. Floats it up on middle and leg, Bailey goes straight down the ground. In the air for a long time but also clears the long on fence with ease.
Drifting in around off, worked with soft hands towards the leg side.
Flatter in trajectory outside off, Head gets back and glides it to short third man for a single.
Full toss outside leg, Head swats it away towards deep mid-wicket for a brace as Behardien makes a fine stop.
Slider on middle and off, punched off the back foot down to long on for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven through the covers for a single.

SIX! MISHIT BUT CLEARS THE ROPES! The bats these days I tell you! Fullish outside off, Bailey goes for the booming drive over cover but gets it off the thickish outside edge. Doesn't matter to him though as it clears the ropes at deep point.
Fuller around off, Bailey leans forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
BEATEN! Slower ball outside off, Bailey tries to down the ground but misses.
Fuller outside off, Bailey pushes it towards cover.
Length ball on middle and off, Head bunts it towards mid on for a single.
Slower ball on middle and leg, Bailey pulls it to the leg side for a single.
FARHAAN BEHARDIEN comes on to bowl.
Drags it short on leg stump, pulled away down to fine leg for a single.
Slider outside off, Bailey plays the reverse sweep towards point.
Drifting away from outside off, Bailey leans forward and blocks it to cover.
Floats it up outside off, pushed firmly towards cover.
Flatter on off, blocked well from the crease.

RUN OUT CHANCE MISSED! What happened there? Poor from Tahir! Flatter down the leg side, Head tucks it towards short fine leg for a single. Hesitant running and he is really struggling to make it to the other end. Parnell's throw is decent but Tahir wasn't up to the stumps to collect it. The southpaw survives.
First of signs of spin today. IMRAN TAHIR comes on to bowl.
Good length on leg stump, worked down to long leg for a single.
Good length wider outside off, pushed off the front foot towards mid off.
Fuller on middle and leg, Head drives it firmly back at Phehlukwayo who gets a hand to parry it towards mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, Bailey pings it towards mid off for a quick single.
GOOD BALL! Good length outside off, shaping away as Bailey is beaten on the poke.
Fuller on middle and off, driven firmly towards mid on.
FOUR! ANOTHER FINE SHOT! Pitched up on middle and leg, easy pickings for Head who gets across to work it away sweetly through mid-wicket. Races away to the fence for a boundary.
Good length outside off, a touch wide and shaping further away. Head leaves.
Length ball a touch wider outside off, no shot offered to that one.

FOUR! HEAD IS AWAY! Fuller on middle and off, worked away sweetly through mid-wicket for a boundary to get off the mark. All the Aussie batsmen have started well but not quite carried on. Can Travis get going?
Back of a length outside off, Bailey hangs back and slices it past backward point towards short third man. Single taken.
Shortish on off, blocked well off the back foot.
TRAVIS HEAD walks out to bat.

OUT! PHEHLUKWAYO GETS HIS THIRD! He's having a dream match so far! Back of a length outside off, extra bounce off the deck as Marsh pushes at it. The outside edge flies to the right of de Kock who takes a brilliant tumbling one-handed catch. Australian batsmen continue to get starts and then get out.
Wide! Another high bouncer and Marsh doesn't offer a stroke. Wide called for height.
Fuller on off, Marsh bunts it straight back to Andile who almost got a hand to it as the ball crashes the stumps at the bowler's end. Had he got a hand on it, Bailey was a goner!
FOUR! SMASHED AWAY! Absolute nonchalance from Marsh! Short from Phehlukwayo and Mitchell stands tall to maul the pull over mid-wicket. That was going to the boundary as soon as he hit it.
Dug in short from around off, Marsh doesn't offer a shot to that one. Wide called for height.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed late off the back foot down to third man for a single.
Pitched up outside off, another flowing drive from Marsh to deep cover. Single taken.
Fullish outside off, driven to sweeper cover for a single.
Good length angled away from outside off, driven off the front foot towards point.
Length ball around off, Mitchell gets behind the line well and blocks it back to the bowler.
Good length angled away from outside off, Marsh gets the stride in and blocks.
Back of a length outside off, defended off the back foot towards point.
FOUR! MORE RUNS FOR MARSH! Fuller on middle and leg, Marsh goes across to that one and drags it through mid-wicket with a swipe. Gets it through the infield and the ball speeds away to the ropes.
Length ball angled in from around off, Bailey stays back and jams it to the leg side.
Length ball on off, defended nicely off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Good length on off, Bailey stays in the crease and pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller and outside off, nicely driven by Bailey but straight to mid off.
Shortish outside off, Bailey gets behind the line and blocks it well.
Good length outside off, punched off the back foot to deep cover for a single.
Leg bye! Shortish on leg stump, Marsh goes across to flick but the ball rolls off the pads towards square leg. They take a leg bye.
Back of a length outside off, GB gets back and steers it down to third man for a single.
Good length outside off, Bailey defends it well from the crease.
Good length on middle and leg, Marsh clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish outside off, upper cut from Bailey as the ball goes down to third man for a single.
FOUR! CREAMED! Loosener from Parnell after the drinks break. Bailey leans into it and plays a scorching drive off the front foot. Gets it well to the left of mid off and it races away to the fence.
WAYNE PARNELL is back on.
Drinks break...
Length ball around off, Marsh hangs back and defends it well.

FOUR! IN THE AIR BUT SAFE! Short ball on middle and leg, Marsh goes for the pull and it was in the air for a while. But falls safe and races to the deep square leg fence. Marsh continues to motor along.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover.
Shortish on off, Bailey goes back to pull and mistimes it towards mid on for a single.
Good length outside off, Bailey stays back and defends it.
PLAY AND A MISS! Fuller and outside off, a hint of away movement as Bailey is beaten on the push.
Good length outside off, left alone by Marsh to the keeper.
FOUR! HAMMERED! Marsh is into top gear! Short on middle and leg, Marsh stays back and swats the pull through mid-wicket to find the fence. Rides the bounce well and struck it with aplomb.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
FOUR! POOR BALL! Attempted yorker turns into a full toss and Marsh obliges with a firm drive past mid off to find the fence. He's certainly come out there with strong intent.
Fuller on off, fine drive this time but straight back to Rabada who gets a hand on it.

SIX! SMASHED! No sighters needed for him it seems! Fuller on middle and leg, Marsh shuffles across and drop kicks it over deep backward square leg with a powerful flick. Strong bottom hand and that sailed away.
KAGISO RABADA is back on.
Short ball on middle and leg, Marsh mistimes the pull towards square leg. Will get a run nevertheless.
Back of a length outside off, Marsh hangs back and blocks it out.
MITCHELL MARSH walks out to bat.

OUT! DOUBLE STRIKE FROM PHEHLUKWAYO! What an over this is! Length ball angled in on middle and leg, Smith shuffles well across the stumps to flick but is rapped on the pads. Loud appeal for lbw and given instantly. Looked plumb to the naked eye as well but Smith after a chat with Bailey, decides to review it. Nothing on the Hot Spot or Snicko which means no inside edge. Hawk Eye shows it pitching in line, impact is perfect too and hitting middle stump. Waste of a review! Australia in a bit of trouble now.
Smith has been given out lbw. He opts for the review.
Full and outside off, Smith leans forward and blocks it out.
Wide! Dug in short around off, no shot offered and wide given for height.
Full and outside off, nicely driven off the front foot towards mid off for a single.
GEORGE BAILEY is the new man in.

OUT! TOP CATCH FROM PARNELL! You just can't keep him out from the action, can you? Shortish on middle and leg, Finch goes across the stumps to work it down the leg side. Parnell at short fine leg dives to his left to take what seems like a brilliant low catch. The umpires aren't sure and want to check it upstairs. Lots of replays and it seems to be a tough call for the third umpire. Usually you see the benefit of the doubt going the batsman's way but this time the bowling side gets it. To be fair to the third umpire, some angles did show it to be a pretty fair catch. Timely strike for the Proteas.
Dug in short on middle and leg, Smith goes for the pull but misses.
Shortish around off, punched off the back foot to the bowler.
FOUR! FAB SHOT! Full and wide outside off, Smith leans into it and drills it through the covers with a beautiful drive. Finds the gap to perfection.
Back of a length on off, Smith looks to block but is hit on the thigh pad.
Back of a length on middle and off, Smith stays back to block and gets an inside edge on to the pads.
FOUR! SMITH IS OFF AND RUNNING! Fuller on leg stump, Smith's favorite zone and he shuffles across to clip it through mid-wicket for a boundary.

FOUR! SHOT! Finch on fire now! Short and wide outside off, sublime from Finch as he stays back to glide it towards the square third man fence for a boundary. Used the pace of the bowler to perfection.

FOUR! SLAPPED AWAY! Phehlukwayo overcompensates with a shorter delivery on off. Finch was waiting on the back foot and muscles the pull over mid-wicket. It was in the air but also well over the infield.
SIX! BOOM!  That's rammed into the sightscreen! Full ball on off, Finch goes big straight down the ground with a clean lofted stroke. Not much foot movement there, just quick hands and sheer power.
Back of a length angled in on leg stump, Finch gets across and tucks it down to fine leg for a brace.
Shortish outside off, Finch hangs back and blocks it towards cover.
Back of a length on middle and leg, pushed off the back foot to mid-wicket.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. Four fielders can now be allowed outside the 30-yard circle. ANDILE PHEHLUKWAYO comes into the attack.
Shortish on middle and leg, clipped off the back foot to the leg side.
Fullish outside off, Smith gets forward and pushed towards mid off.
Back of a length angled away outside off, jabbed off the back foot to the off side.
STEVEN SMITH walks out to bat.

OUT! GONE! THE BOWLING CHANGE WORKS! Slower ball outside off, Warner is early into the drive and tries to check his shot. Too late though, as he lobs it straight to Andile at mid off who takes it with ease. Soft dismissal in the end and it's a big strike for SA.
Shortish on middle and leg, Finch muscles the pull through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! MIGHTY BLOW! Finch is getting into his groove now. Length ball outside off, gets forward and launches it through the line with a loft over long off for a biggie. Stylish stroke.
WAYNE PARNELL comes on to bowl.
Length ball around off, Warner stays in the crease and jabs it to the off side.
Back of a length on middle and leg, Finch clips it through square leg for a single.
Short of a length around off, Warner opens the bat face to glide it down to third man for a single.
Good length angled in on leg stump, Finch works it down to fine leg for a single.
Length ball wide outside off, Warner carves it over cover with a big slice. Doesn't go to the fence but they'll take three.
Length ball outside off, Warner gets forward and pushes it to cover.

Two Leg Byes! Fullish on middle and leg, Finch gets across to flick but the ball rolls off the pads down to fine leg. Stifled appeal for lbw but that was missing leg. Brilliant running adds a couple of leg byes to the total.
Another bumper around off, Finch evades it by ducking under it.
Short ball on middle and leg, Finch ducks under it.
Back of a length on leg stump, Warner gets back and works it towards square leg for a single.
Wide! Straying well down the leg side, Warner doesn't connect the flick. Wide called.
Back of a length around leg stump, Warner gets back to flick but is hit on the thigh. Extra bounce on offer.
Leg bye! Good length on leg stump, Finch goes across to flick but the ball rolls off the pads towards backward square leg. Leg bye taken.
Length ball outside off, Warner leans into it and drives it towards cover-point.
Back of a length on leg stump, tucked off the back foot towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! STRAIGHT AS AN ARROW! What a shot! Overpitched outside off, in the slot and Warner leans forward to lift it calmly straight over the bowler's head. Got it very straight and the ball sails down the ground to the fence.
Good length closer to off, better from Steyn and Warner jabs it with soft hands towards the slip cordon on the bounce.
Length ball on middle and off, Warner gets right behind the line and defends it firmly to cover.
Back of a length on off, blocked well off the back foot towards cover.
Full ball outside off, Warner bunts it towards mid off for a sharp single.
Back of a length outside off, sliced off the back foot towards point.

FOUR! BANG! Not sure what Rabada said last ball but Warner has reacted in style. Poor ball too as it's a full toss outside off, creamed through cover where the fielder misfields to allow the boundary. Ominous signs for the Proteas.

Back of a length angling away outside off, loose from Warner as he goes for the dab to third man. Extra bounce and the ball beats his edge. Rabada isn't amused and has something to say to the southpaw.
Short and wide once more outside off, Warner misses out this time as his back foot slap finds the fielder at point.

Good length outside off, Warner leans forward and taps it towards mid off for a quick single. Direct hit at the bowler's end but he was well in. The batsmen get the second run off the ricochet as the ball goes towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! FINDS THE FENCE! This should calm his nerves a bit! Length ball drifting into middle and leg, Finch shuffles across and flicks it away through backward square leg as the ball races to the fence.
PLAY AND A MISS! Finch is struggling to get going! Length ball outside off, moves away a bit late as Finch goes for the flashing drive on the up through cover. Doesn't connect.
Length ball around off, nips in a bit and Finch punches it off the back foot towards mid on.
Good length just around off, comes back in a touch as Finch chops it towards mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, Warner reaches out and pings it to cover for a single. He's timing it very sweetly!

SIX! THAT'S IN THE STANDS! The South Africans are getting their length wrong to Warner. Another short ball on leg stump, he just swivels across and helps it on its way over fine leg for a maximum with a pull.
Length ball outside off, Warner pushes it towards cover for a single to keep strike.

Length ball outside off, Warner leans into it and hammers the drive towards mid off. Andile over there lost his balance for a while but stopped it just in time with his left hand. Saved a certain boundary.
Wide! Short ball from Rabada but it's too high. Warner ducks and it's a wide.
Top ball! Terrific yorker on off, Warner does very well to dig that one out just in time.
Full and outside off, blistering drive from Warner but he cannot find the gap at cover.
FOUR! UP AND OVER! Warner seems to be in the mood today. Short and wide outside off, sat up nicely for the southpaw who slashed it uppishly well over backward point. Another boundary for David.
Good length around leg stump, Warner gets across to flick but is struck on the pads.
Shortish outside off, punched off the back foot towards mid off. Again the ball was in the air for a while.
FOUR! ALMOST A CHANCE! Tough one though! Pitched up outside off, Finch goes for the aerial drive down the ground. Steyn sticks his left hand but the ball goes just past him. Beats mid off as well.
Good length just around off, Finch gets back to block but is struck high on the pads. Faint inside edge there perhaps.
Leg bye! That bounced a bit! Back of a length on middle and leg, Warner gets back to flick but the ball lobs off the thigh pad towards short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
A touch fuller around off, Warner bunts it back past the bowler down the ground towards mid on.
Good length closer to off, Warner stays in the crease and blocks it well.
Back of a length outside off, Finch defends it well from the crease.
Wide! Short ball and Finch ducks. Too high and wide called.
Length ball wider outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Short of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Back of a length on middle and leg, cramps Warner for room and it is tucked through backward square leg for a single.

FOUR! FAB SHOT! Rabada isn't getting his radar right. Another shortish length ball just outside off and this time Warner stands tall to cut it on the up through point this time. Another boundary to the southpaw. Already signs of a flat deck.
FOUR! SLAPPED AWAY! You just can't bowl there to Warner. Short and wide outside off, allowing him to free his arms and slashes it over backward point uppishly. It raced away to the fence.
KAGISO RABADA to take the other new ball.
Dale Steyn keeps it on the shorter side a bit and gets it to swing away from Aaron Finch. The Aussie rocks back and steers it towards point with an open face. End of the over.
Pitched up fractionally, keeps it on a length here, maybe a little fuller than that, Finch drives this uppishly towards the cover region.

WHOA! What are you doing, Aaron Finch? You're just playing your first ball here. Just back of a length and outside off, Finch stands his ground and goes for the left over the covers. Misses it completely as the ball whiskers past the outside edge.

Shot! Lovely timing on that. Fuller in length and outside off, coming in once more, David Warner leans into this one and pushes it nicely through the covers. Doesn't get all of it but it's enough to fetch him three runs.
On a length once more and pitched outside off, Warner stays deep within his crease and blocks it out with a straight blade.
Steyn is on the money right away! Bowls a length ball on the stumps, gets it to swing in to David Warner who keeps it out solidly. Good start.
The players and the umpires are out in the middle. It will be David Warner and Aaron Finch to open the Aussie innings while Dale Steyn will lead the South African bowling charge.

Time for the toss. Faf du Plessis will spin the coin, Steven Smith to call. The visiting captain has called it wrong. SOUTH AFRICA WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BOWL. Hashim Amla misses out for the hosts due to illness and Rilee Rossouw takes his place.

Hello and a warm welcome to the opening encounter of Australia's brief tour of South Africa that includes five ODIs with the hosts. Both teams are without some key players and it shall be interesting to see which side adjusts better with the replacements. Inexperience in bowling is Australia's concern while a top-heavy batting is South Africa's worry. The surface at Supersport Park usually is a good pitch with even bounce and good pace. Stay tuned as the toss is coming up shortly.
